name: Monero
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Monero discloses that its community crowdfunding wallet was drained of 2,675.73 XMR (the entire balance). The hot wallet, used for payments to contributors, is untouched; its balance is ~244 XMR.
